record.question: Which of the following sports item is voted back into the Olympic sport roster?
record.explanation: IOC's September 2013 decision added wrestling to the 2020 and 2024 Olympic programmes, defeating baseball/softball and squash. Interpret voted back relative to June 2014. Historical exam context: 2014-06 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed.
